retention_tricks: Fast Cuts: Rapid scene changes every 1-3 seconds to maintain visual interest.
Text Overlays: On-screen text highlighting key points or adding humor.
Sound Design: Use trending sounds, sound effects, and upbeat background music.
Open Loops: Hinting at future revelations or a 'part 2' to maintain curiosity.
Suspenseful Builds: Gradually revealing information or building up to a climax.
Relatable Content: Addressing common pain points, experiences, or aspirations.
